role: Social post and conversation scalar coordination
known_patches: Integer identity schemas and synthetic source persona
Original source semantics bounded by actual probes
limitations: All 118 source tools retained; eight declared tools certify Post/comment/aspect/conversation/message and notification scalar state. No network/federation delivery or scheduling claim.
session.person_id maps existing User.id only under the asserted source User/Person identity alignment; helpers retain Person scaffold. No generic arbitrary user/person mapping claimed.
create_conversation creates no participant visibility rows; send_message/api_list_messages require auth but do not enforce actual conversation participation. No private-message confidentiality claim.
read_stream/get_post expose public posts; aspect/private delivery, mute/hide and complete feed semantics are not certified.
Source create_status_message writes Post only, not a second StatusMessage subtype row; comments and messages are scalar records, not federation events.
